Items.Name: Manglik Dosha
Items.Description: Manglik Dosha is considered when Mars influences sensitive houses connected with marriage, domestic harmony, and longevity of partnership.

Statements: Partnerships may need patience, direct communication, and conscious anger management.
There can be intensity in emotional reactions during conflict.
Marriage decisions benefit from careful compatibility review and maturity.
Domestic peace may fluctuate when decisions are rushed or ego-driven.
Family adjustment can require active listening and steady boundaries.
A disciplined lifestyle helps reduce friction at home.
Mars can give strong ambition, courage, and ability to act under pressure.
Impulsive professional choices may create avoidable stress.
Leadership improves when energy is directed through planning.
Stress, heat, inflammation, or accident-prone tendencies may need attention.
Exercise and disciplined routines help channel excess Mars energy.
Anger and impatience can affect sleep and physical recovery.
Regular prayer and service can soften harsh Mars expression.
Discipline, humility, and restraint become important spiritual remedies.
Tuesday-based worship routines may support emotional balance.

Remedies: Worship Lord Hanuman or Lord Subramanya on Tuesdays.
Recite Mangal mantra or Hanuman Chalisa with discipline.
Match with another Manglik chart or review cancellation factors before final judgment.

Items.Name: Kaal Sarpa Dosha
Items.Description: Kaal Sarpa Dosha is indicated when all visible planets are enclosed within the Rahu-Ketu axis.

Statements: The native may feel inner pressure, restlessness, or repeated mental loops.
Life can feel extreme during Rahu and Ketu periods.
Emotional stability improves through structure and spiritual grounding.
Progress may come after delays, reversals, or unusual turns.
Recognition can improve once focus and direction become stable.
Unconventional fields, research, technology, or hidden domains may attract the native.
Trust and expectations may need conscious management.
Relationships can feel karmic, intense, or transformative.
Clear communication reduces misunderstandings during stressful periods.
Financial patterns may show sudden gains and sudden expenses.
Speculative decisions should be handled carefully.
Long-term planning helps reduce Rahu-Ketu volatility.
This dosha can push the native toward deeper self-study and detachment.
Rahu-Ketu remedies and mantra practice may bring steadiness.
Service, charity, and disciplined routines reduce karmic pressure.

Remedies: Perform Rahu-Ketu shanti or Navagraha shanti with a qualified priest.
Worship Lord Shiva and recite Mahamrityunjaya mantra.
Strengthen disciplined service, charity, and spiritual practice during Rahu/Ketu periods.

Items.Name: Chandra Grahan Dosha
Items.Description: Chandra Grahan Dosha is considered when Moon is closely associated with Rahu or Ketu, affecting emotional clarity, peace of mind, and mental steadiness.

Statements: Emotional ups and downs, overthinking, or excessive worry may be more noticeable.
The native may find it difficult to maintain mental peace during stressful periods.
Mood swings, sleep disturbance, or vivid dreams can appear when the Moon is activated.
The relationship with mother or maternal figures may feel emotionally fluctuating.
Trust issues, emotional dependency, or emotional detachment may appear in close bonds.
Expressing feelings clearly may require conscious effort and maturity.
Decision-making may feel confused when emotions and fear dominate judgment.
Recognition can be delayed despite effort, especially during Rahu or Ketu periods.
Success often improves after mental maturity and stable direction develop.
Financial decisions may be influenced by mood, anxiety, or impulse.
Savings habits can become inconsistent without a clear plan.
Unexpected gains and losses may appear during Rahu or Ketu periods.
Stress-related issues, headaches, or migraines may need attention.
Sleep disorders or psychosomatic complaints can arise under emotional pressure.
Calming routines and emotional regulation support overall health.
This placement can increase interest in meditation, mantra, and inner healing.
Moon-strengthening practices help build emotional steadiness.
Worship of Lord Shiva and disciplined Monday observances may support peace of mind.

Remedies: Worship Lord Shiva and recite Mahamrityunjaya mantra.
Donate white items such as rice, milk, or cloth on Mondays.
Practice moon-strengthening routines such as meditation, water offerings, and disciplined sleep.

Items.Name: Surya Grahan Dosha
Items.Description: Surya Grahan Dosha is considered when Sun is closely associated with Rahu or Ketu, affecting confidence, authority, fatherly support, visibility, and inner clarity.

Statements: Confidence may fluctuate between strong ambition and self-doubt.
The native may feel unseen or misunderstood by authority figures.
Identity becomes stronger when ego, duty, and discipline are aligned.
Recognition may come after delays or unusual turns.
Authority conflicts can arise when decisions are ego-driven.
Leadership improves when transparency and accountability are practiced.
Relationship with father, mentors, or senior figures may need healing.
Family expectations can feel heavy during Sun, Rahu, or Ketu periods.
Respectful communication reduces pride-based distance.
Vitality, eyes, headaches, or heat-related stress may need attention.
Regular routine and sunlight discipline support steadiness.
Overwork can reduce natural radiance and confidence.
Sun-related discipline supports humility and clarity.
Service to fatherly figures, teachers, or elders can be beneficial.
Daily prayer at sunrise may stabilize the Sun principle.

Remedies: Offer water to the rising Sun with discipline and humility.
Recite Aditya Hridayam or Surya mantra on Sundays.
Serve father, teachers, elders, or public causes without pride.

Items.Name: Guru Chandal Dosha
Items.Description: Guru Chandal Dosha is considered when Jupiter is closely associated with Rahu or Ketu, affecting judgment, faith, teachers, ethics, and guidance.

Statements: Beliefs may become unconventional, intense, or frequently questioned.
The native may struggle to trust teachers or traditional guidance.
Wisdom matures when curiosity is balanced with humility.
Advisory, teaching, legal, financial, or spiritual roles need extra ethical clarity.
Shortcuts or exaggerated promises should be avoided.
Progress improves through qualified mentors and disciplined study.
Differences in values or belief systems may affect close relationships.
The native may attract unusual teachers, guides, or advisors.
Respecting wisdom traditions without blind faith brings balance.
Speculative decisions based on hype or overconfidence can create risk.
Financial judgment improves through verified information.
Long-term planning is better than promises of sudden growth.
The placement can create deep spiritual inquiry after confusion.
Guru worship and service to teachers support correction.
Truthfulness and charity strengthen Jupiter's higher expression.

Remedies: Respect and serve genuine teachers, elders, and spiritual guides.
Recite Guru mantra or Vishnu Sahasranama on Thursdays.
Donate yellow food, books, or education support according to capacity.

Items.Name: Pitra Dosha
Items.Description: Pitra Dosha is considered when Sun, the 9th house, or the 9th lord is afflicted, indicating pressure connected with father, ancestors, lineage blessings, duty, and inherited karmic patterns.

Statements: The native may feel unresolved responsibility toward family or ancestors.
Relationship with father or paternal elders can require maturity and forgiveness.
Family patterns may repeat until consciously addressed.
Blessings and opportunities may improve after discipline and service.
Luck can feel delayed when duties are neglected.
Respecting tradition while acting ethically supports dharma.
Mentor support may fluctuate or arrive later in life.
Professional stability improves when commitments are honored.
Work connected with public duty, service, or guidance may activate growth.
Ancestral remembrance and gratitude become important remedies.
Pitru-related rituals may help bring emotional closure.
Charity in the name of ancestors supports lineage healing.

Remedies: Perform ancestor remembrance, tarpan, or Pitru shanti with proper guidance.
Serve parents, elders, and needy people with sincerity.
Donate food, clothes, or essentials in the name of ancestors.

Items.Name: Shani Dosha
Items.Description: Shani Dosha is considered when Saturn strongly pressures sensitive houses or Moon, indicating delay, responsibility, fear, burden, discipline, and karmic correction.

Statements: The native may feel heaviness, loneliness, fear, or delayed emotional ease.
Patience becomes a key life lesson.
Mental steadiness improves through structure and realistic expectations.
Growth may be slow but durable when effort is consistent.
Responsibility can arrive early or feel heavier than expected.
Long-term work, systems, service, and discipline support success.
Relationships may require patience, loyalty, and practical commitment.
Emotional distance can appear when fear is not expressed clearly.
Stable bonds improve through trust built over time.
Bones, joints, chronic fatigue, or stress stiffness may need care.
Regular movement and disciplined sleep support Saturn balance.
Neglected habits can become long-term burdens.
Service to the poor, elderly, workers, and disadvantaged people reduces harshness.
Humility and steady duty are important spiritual remedies.
Saturday discipline can bring calm and endurance.

Remedies: Serve elderly people, workers, or the poor on Saturdays.
Recite Shani mantra or Hanuman Chalisa with discipline.
Donate black sesame, oil, blankets, or footwear according to capacity.

Items.Name: Kemadruma Dosha
Items.Description: Kemadruma Dosha is considered when Moon lacks supportive planets in adjacent houses, showing emotional isolation, inconsistent support, and difficulty feeling settled.

Statements: The native may feel emotionally unsupported even when people are present.
Mood and confidence can fluctuate with environment.
Inner steadiness grows through routine, community, and self-nourishment.
Support from family or close friends may feel inconsistent.
The native may prefer independence but still need emotional reassurance.
Healthy emotional communication reduces isolation.
Income and savings can fluctuate if emotional decisions drive spending.
Stability improves through simple budgeting and repeated habits.
A practical support system helps avoid impulsive choices.
Moon remedies and meditation help stabilize the mind.
Service connected with food, water, or care-giving supports emotional healing.
Gratitude routines reduce the feeling of lack.

Remedies: Strengthen Moon through Monday prayer, meditation, and disciplined sleep.
Donate rice, milk, or white food according to capacity.
Spend time near water and practice calming daily routines.

Items.Name: Daridra Dosha
Items.Description: Daridra Dosha is considered when wealth lords or wealth houses are under dusthana, Saturn, or node pressure, indicating instability in savings, gains, and material comfort.

Statements: Savings may fluctuate due to pressure on income or family resources.
Sudden expenses or unstable gains can appear during difficult periods.
Financial discipline, budgeting, and conservative planning become important.
Earnings may improve after delays, skill-building, and consistent work.
Speculative or unclear financial opportunities should be reviewed carefully.
Stable income grows through practical planning rather than shortcuts.
Family responsibilities may influence savings and resources.
Speech, values, and money habits may need conscious correction.
Clear agreements reduce financial misunderstandings.
Charity and gratitude help reduce scarcity thinking.
Lakshmi and Vishnu worship may support prosperity discipline.
Giving within one's means is more important than display.

Remedies: Maintain disciplined budgeting and avoid speculative financial decisions.
Worship Goddess Lakshmi or Lord Vishnu on Fridays or Thursdays.
Donate food, grains, or practical support to needy people according to capacity.
